video_title: Melo Says Angel Reese Has PROVEN She's More Than Caitlin Clark's Rival

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on the WNBA Finals defensive matchup
quotes.excerpt: It's going to be about defense. So just wrap your mind around that.
quotes.quote: It's going to be about defense. So just wrap your mind around that. Golden State has literally been the best defense in the league and the Dream have been top five in offensive and defensive rating all season. They also defend, but they have more firepower. So I do think there's an advantage Atlanta because of their offense. But when I tell you ball-halla, which is what the, it's different. It's crazy. It's like the Warriors games in there. Yes, crazy. And so they have home court advantage if it does end up getting pushed to seven. I'd be surprised if it takes that many, but if it has to go to a game seven in ball-halla, then that's the Valkyries are in it.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on Angel Reese's impact and development
quotes.excerpt: She has reiterated to me the power of being put in a good situation.
quotes.quote: When she was coming out of LSU, I was kind of like, is it going to translate? Is it going to work? And yes, first of all, even before she was defensive player of the year, the rebounding is just relentless, it's undeniable. So I think she has reiterated to me the power of being put in a good situation because not much has changed from her game, outside of Carl Smaw, the head coach in Atlanta working with her on her three-point shooting. But she talks so glowingly about the team in Atlanta and they talk the same way about her. And so while she picked up defensive player of the year, she said this could easily be Ryan's award or Jordan Canada's award. They are really a team that is rooting for one another and doing something special.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the pressure of being linked to a star
quotes.excerpt: When you're linked to somebody and the pendulum is already swung over here to that person, you feel like you got to work five times as harder.
quotes.quote: When you're linked to somebody and the pendulum is already swung over here to that person, you feel like you got to work five times as harder to just continue to be part of that conversation. For Angel, I'm sure she felt that way. Like damn, no matter what the fuck I do, like I'm, I'm a winner. I've won in elementary, I won in middle and high school, in college and I'm about to win in the pros. I'm gold medalist. Like when you talk about the, the, the body of work in a short period of time, we, we talking about something special.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on athletes establishing their own legacy
quotes.excerpt: Now we're seeing an athlete getting their feet wet, getting their feet underneath of them, establishing who they are as an athlete.
quotes.quote: Now we're seeing an athlete getting their feet wet, getting their feet underneath of them, establishing who they are as an athlete and, and, and, and really comprehending their value and their impact, right? And, and now starting to create your own lane because now I don't, don't put me with that no more. Don't put me with that no more. I don't even want that and if y'all, y'all going to continue to do it anyway. But now I'm over here and I'm carving out my own shit. I believed in myself. I was in Chicago, I told y'all, this is what I come here to do. I come here to win. I'm a winner. You may not like my approach to it. So put me with a team and put me with a group of women that understands my approach.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on the fallacy of limiting athletes to one role
quotes.excerpt: This idea that an athlete has to be one thing just has to be put to bed across the board.
quotes.quote: This idea that an athlete has to be one thing just has to be put to bed across the board. Angel is doing a great job of it in the women's lane. There's obviously a ton of guys on the NBA side who have other endeavors and things that matter to them. Like you can, the beauty of being an athlete is that you learn how to juggle so many things. So why would you limit an athlete to being one thing?
